body:
Fixes #2023

## Summary

- Classify `Claude stream ended without a terminal result event...` as a retryable transient Claude failure.
- Build the missing-result message before retry classification so the existing retry path can resume the captured session with `--resume <sessionId>`.
- Add a regression test that reproduces the captured `Exit code 144` stream ending without a terminal `result` event, then verifies the second invocation resumes successfully.
- Preserve the requested issue logs, metadata, before/after regression evidence, and analysis under `docs/case-studies/issue-2023`.
- Add a patch changeset.

## Reproduction

The archived run emitted failed tool results containing `Exit code 144`, then the Claude stream closed without a terminal `result` event. Hive Mind built this failure message too late for transient classification:

```text
Claude stream ended without a terminal result event after: Exit code 144
```

At classification time `lastMessage` was still only `Exit code 144`, so no retry happened even though the logs also printed manual `claude --resume 6e01ef90-...` commands. The new focused regression test failed before the fix and passes after it.

## Verification

- `node scripts/npm-install-with-retry.mjs ci`
- `node tests/test-issue-2023-claude-missing-result-resume.mjs`
- `node tests/test-issue-1974-claude-stream-completion.mjs`
- `node tests/test-issue-1937-stream-idle-timeout-retry.mjs`
- `npm run lint`
- `npm run format:check`
- `git diff --check`
- `bash scripts/check-file-line-limits.sh`

`npm test` was run locally and stopped once at `tests/test-issue-1209-overrides.mjs` when its first subtest hit the 12s timeout under local Node 20.20.2. Rerunning that file by itself passed all 11 cases; the repo declares Node `>=24.0.0` and CI runs on Node 24.x.
